slice: tenant-scoped soil-test observations and advisory nutrient rates

tests.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_gateway_nutrient_soil_tests.py tests/test_gateway_nutrient_balances.py tests/test_nutrient_budget.py tests/test_operator_auth.py -q

verified_contract: Exact private nutrient_budget:read location policy; other methods and suffixes do not match
Invalid location UUID and pagination fail before opening PostgreSQL
Repeatable-read, read-only transaction installs signed tenant context before count and page queries
Both soil-test queries filter the requested location and only recorded/verified lifecycle states
Rows are ordered deterministically and bounded by page size and offset limits
Plot IDs are returned only when the related farm belongs to the requested location
Recorded status remains recorded; verified status remains verified
Measurements and advisory N/P/K rates are projected without notes, metadata, or location names
The connection is rolled back and closed; authenticated HTTP responses are no-store and missing grants deny before the handler
rollback: Remove the additive Gateway route, exact policy, service module, test, and documentation; no schema or data rollback is needed.
